title: I am now absolutely certain that Mallworld is a universe that does not exist only in our minds

classification.theory_summary: Author argues Mallworld is a fixed/external place consciousness visits during sleep; suggests potential shared Mallworld experiences across people/universes/times and proposes generating images to compare locations.
classification.skip_reason: No concrete dream scene descriptions (no specific locations, sensory qualities, sequences, or interactions); primarily a theory/meta claim about Mallworld being external and shareable.

meta.author_theory: Mallworld is not subconscious; it is a fixed place/dimension that consciousness travels to during sleep; people can meet there even if they don't remember; time/frequency differs from waking reality.

extraction.extraction_notes: Only phenomenological elements present are recurrence claims (same place >10 times), unfamiliarity (not real-world, not similar, not familiar), and presence of dream-encountered people known only within dreams. No describable environment features (light, layout, cleanliness, crowding, etc.) were provided.
